prompt: Compose an original complete 30-second instrumental cue for uplifting architecture and open landscapes. Instruments: clean guitar harmonics, bass, restrained acoustic drums. 120 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a clipped falling fifth answered by two repeated notes. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: An upbeat and groovy instrumental track featuring a prominent electric guitar melody, a driving bassline, and a steady drum beat. It has a positive and energetic feel, suitable for various promotional or background uses.
description.zh: 一首欢快且律动感十足的纯音乐，以突出的电吉他旋律、强劲的贝斯线和稳定的鼓点为特色。它营造出积极而充满活力的氛围，适合各种宣传或背景用途。

audioReview.reason: The track is well-produced, has a clear structure, and a positive, energetic vibe without any defects, making it suitable for a music library.
audioReview.shortFormReason: The track opens immediately with a catchy electric guitar riff and full band instrumentation. It concludes with a clear, deliberate final chord and drum hit, providing a resolved musical ending.

description.en: An upbeat and energetic instrumental track featuring a prominent electric guitar melody, driving bassline, and solid drum beat. It has a positive and lively pop-rock feel with a touch of funk.
